wuduSteps.title: Niyyah & Bismillah
wuduSteps.description: Make the silent intention in your heart and say 'Bismillah'.

wuduSteps.title: Washing Hands
wuduSteps.description: Wash both hands up to the wrists thoroughly 3 times.

wuduSteps.title: Rinsing Mouth
wuduSteps.description: Rinse your mouth thoroughly 3 times with your right hand.

wuduSteps.title: Inhaling Water in Nose
wuduSteps.description: Sniff water gently into nostrils and blow out 3 times.

wuduSteps.title: Washing Face
wuduSteps.description: Wash your entire face from hairline to chin 3 times.

wuduSteps.title: Washing Arms to Elbows
wuduSteps.description: Wash right arm to elbow 3 times, then left arm 3 times.

wuduSteps.title: Wiping Head (Masah)
wuduSteps.description: Wipe over head with wet hands once.

wuduSteps.title: Wiping Ears
wuduSteps.description: Wipe inside and outside of both ears once.

wuduSteps.title: Washing Feet to Ankles
wuduSteps.description: Wash right foot then left foot including ankles 3 times.

salahSteps.title: Takbirat al-Ihram
salahSteps.description: Face Qibla, raise hands and begin prayer.

salahSteps.title: Qiyam & Fatihah
salahSteps.description: Recite Surah Al-Fatihah and an additional passage from the Quran.

salahSteps.title: Ruku (Bowing)
salahSteps.description: Bow with back straight and hands on knees.

salahSteps.title: I'tidal (Standing)
salahSteps.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ • رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
salahSteps.transliteration: Sami'allahu liman hamidah • Rabbana wa lakal-hamd
salahSteps.description: Rise up straight and praise Allah.

salahSteps.title: Tashahhud
salahSteps.description: Recite the testimony of faith and Durood Ibrahim.

salahSteps.title: Tasleem
salahSteps.description: Turn head right then left to end prayer.
